Making Friends with Boredom

For anyone who reaches for a screen the moment things get quiet. Each day is one small way to sit with a dull moment, let your mind wander and find the ideas and calm that boredom can hold.

Mindfulness · Mindfulness · Self-Care · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Take one slow breath the next time a quiet moment arrives, and simply let it stay quiet.
  • Day 2Look out the nearest window for one minute and let your thoughts drift wherever they like.
  • Day 3Put a small notebook somewhere you will see it today, ready for any idea that wanders in during a quiet moment.
  • Day 4Ask a friend or family member what they enjoy doing on a slow afternoon, and really listen to the reply.
  • Day 5Notice the very next moment you feel bored today and quietly name it to yourself: this is boredom.
  • Day 6Wait in the next line you join with your phone tucked in a pocket, and look around the room instead.
  • Day 7Daydream on purpose for five minutes this afternoon, eyes soft, with no goal at all.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Pause halfway through a dull task and notice what you most want to do instead, without doing it yet.
  • Day 60Write down what was happening just before you felt bored this afternoon.
  • Day 120Check in with yourself after scrolling for a while, comparing how you feel now with before, with curiosity and no blame.
  • Day 240Compare a bright summer morning with a cloudy one, and notice whether boredom feels any lighter in the sun.
  • Day 365Thank yourself for one moment this season when you stayed with boredom instead of rushing past it.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
